name: Miyama (Fukui, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyama town emblem in green: a disc enclosing a stylised character with two strokes rising from the top.
history: Flag of the former town of Miyama in Fukui Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-02-01.

features.role: Miyama town emblem — a disc enclosing a stylised character with two strokes rising from the top
